Hall of Nonsense
How to play

A patient’s guide to causing trouble.

Keyboard

WASD / arrows: move
Space: swing (hold to keep swinging; a held run spins)
Shift / J: jump
Q: dash
hold R: barf-bag shield
B: brick (3 a fight, find more)
F: eat a nutrient
M: map
Enter: nearby arcade
Esc: pause

Phones and tablets: the joystick

Turn the phone sideways for the big room
Left thumb: the joystick. Double-tap it (the » on the stick) to dash whichever way you push
EAT right beside the stick: one nutrient, one heart
SWING in the corner: tap to hit, hold to keep swinging (every third held swing spins), drag to aim
JUMP beside it, SHIELD (hold it) above it
BRICK between them: the badge says how many are left

Tap the room instead

Tap the floor: walk there
Tap a gremlin: go bonk it. Hold to keep swinging
Flick: dash that way
Two-finger tap: jump
Long-press the floor: shield, for as long as you hold
SHIELD, BRICK, JUMP and EAT stay on screen

The combo

Land three hits in a row without getting hit or whiffing and the ring around SWING fills. Your next swing near a gremlin is a COMBO SLAM: everything close gets knocked back and dizzy, and you get paid. Taps count; a held button still swings, it just does not count.

Medals matter

Bronze is 1 discharge star, silver 2, gold 3. Only your best medal per level counts. A bronze unlocks the next level. Spend coins in the gift shop.

Health has a budget

Every room has a snack cart (the lounge has a vending machine) good for one nutrient; it restocks after a ward clear or two minutes. Cleared waves, every sixth gremlin and some combo slams leave one on the floor. Carry up to 3 (5 with Pocket snacks); each restores a heart. Still no bottomless snack fountain.

The kit

Three bricks a fight, and a few more turn up glinting behind the furniture as the waves come. The barf-bag shield blocks everything while you hold it, until the bag gives out. Inside the bubble you cannot swing.

Every department fights dirty

The MRI magnet yanks bedpans and bruiser helmets into the scanner. The lounge remote zones out anything in front of the TV. Donut II rolls a lane through the CT. Ultrasound gel makes everyone slide. Use it.

Cleared means cleared

Gremlins you evict stay evicted, even if you leave mid-fight. A cleared department stays calm until you ask for a rematch: the button in the strip under the room (tap it twice) or in the pause menu.

Zero hearts

Macy goes back on the IV for one gentle round. Miss it and the nurses patch her up for a few coins. Progress survives, and a failed recovery is still spectacularly anatomical.
